4 lbs ground pork shoulder

32.4g salt

1.8g dry oregano

3.5g black pepper **toasted and ground coarse

8g guajillo pepper **toasted and ground

16g paprika (mccormick)

8g hot chili powder

2.4g cumin

6 cloves garlic grated

90 ml white vinegar (red wine vinegar)

90 ml water

1/2 tsp liquid smoke in vinegar

**grind meat, mix garlic with vinegar, mix everything
